paragraphs.notes: This page is sheet 2 of 2 of the international search report drawn up by the ISA for PCT/EP99/06627. It is an official form appended at the very end of the publication and is NOT part of the disclosure: no description text, no claims, no drawings. Recorded with doc_part 'description' because the schema offers no separate value for it. The form is the German-language version of PCT/ISA/210.

Boxed at the top right. The printed label is broken by ink dropout: 'Interr' is followed by a blank of about two characters and then a damaged 'o' before 'nales Aktenzeichen'. The missing letters are not readable on the scan and are recorded as [illegible] rather than reconstructed. The application number itself is crisp and typed, with a space after the slash as printed: 'PCT/EP 99/06627'.
